(* Encoding.node_copy_correct *)
lemma node_copy_correct:
  forall (s0 : BArray16.t),
    phoare[ CoreExtracted.M.__node_copy : src = s0 ==> res = s0] = (Real.(%r)
                                                                    1).

(* Encoding.node_concat_correct *)
lemma node_concat_correct:
  forall (a0 b0 : BArray16.t),
    phoare[ CoreExtracted.M.__node_concat :
             a = a0 /\ b = b0 ==>
             BArray32.to_list res =
             List.(++) (BArray16.to_list a0) (BArray16.to_list b0)] = (
    Real.(%r) 1).
